title: Mailbox work non-FIFO claims: bounded claim transactions, synthetic PostgreSQL 14 measurement
measuredSnapshotNote: Measured on a frozen copy whose only production difference from this commit is a removed doc comment in claims.rs; every SQL statement hash is identical.
claimPrelude: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s';

environment.database: fresh isolated scratch database per size and statistics state, dropped after the run
environment.schema: production schema through the deployed ledger, then this commit's later migrations; indexes from removed migrations dropped and asserted absent

method: Each claim runs in one READ COMMITTED transaction: the source prelude (lock_timeout 5s, statement_timeout 15s; no advisory lock), phase 1 lock window with maintenance (park up to 64 rows), then the phase 2 fresh-snapshot claim. Phase 1 is measured with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) CREATE TEMP TABLE ... AS EXECUTE, which executes the exact source statement once and keeps its rows for phase 2. Reported buffers, lock rows and execution time are the sums of the two source plans (shared hit + read); the temp table uses local buffers only. Every case runs with force_custom_plan and force_generic_plan. Fresh statistics: full seed then VACUUM ANALYZE; stale: ANALYZE after seeding only the first 20 links, autovacuum disabled, then the rest seeded without new statistics; case setup vacuums without ANALYZE on stale data.

labels.steadyState: ordinary, leased, locked, hot mailbox, empty and parked-heavy cases: Acquired or Idle without maintenance writes
labels.oneTimeMaintenance: ineligible and stale-generation prefixes: Progress calls that park up to 64 rows each
labels.ineligiblePrefixTransition: legitimate: links flipped to needs_reauth (live streams) or inactive (reconciliation) with their due rows first; the real claimer runs until Acquired
labels.reconciliationWrongLabelPrefix1M: legitimate legacy reconciliation rows; sampled per-call buffers grow with dead index entries over the prefix and exceed the claim gate on those calls (open, not tuned here)
labels.unsupportedCorruptStreamMismatch: UNSUPPORTED CORRUPTION, not a legacy state: streams are Outlook-only on main and provider is derived and immutable

criterion: approved benchmark criterion for this synthetic measurement; not a production measurement; no throughput estimate
